description.value: A Subway franchise on the busy Kingsway corridor in Burnaby offering customizable footlong sandwiches, wraps, and salads with fresh-cut vegetables and freshly baked bread. The restaurant features indoor seating with air conditioning and is wheelchair accessible. Cyclists passing through the Kingsway area can order in-restaurant, for pickup, or via delivery.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces, covered) at 15m; stands (3 spaces) at 94m; stands (5 spaces) at 97m. Total: 16 spaces.
